summary: Pass to T = the chosen places and their conjugates, with a filling level F. Lift each s ∈ 𝖦_i to σ(s) ∈ K with reduction ι_i(s). Pointwise on K_T, ∑_s x(s)∑_{(c,a)} amplitudeSum(𝖲, c, ι_i(s)⁻¹, c)(a, a)/ν = columnDim·∑_s x(s)·phase(g, yσ(s)y⁻¹) (if yσ(s)y⁻¹ ∈ 𝖴·K(g) the amplitude sum is ν·unipotentChar·identity, otherwise no term of 𝖲 lies over the class pair and both vanish, by freeness). Integrating over K_T and Cauchy–Schwarz in s give 𝖬(K_T)²·|LHS|² ≤ columnDim²·(∑|x(s)|²)·∑_s |∫_{K_T} phase(yσ(s)y⁻¹)|², with ∑|x(s)|² = Re x(1) ≤ b⁻⁸/2 and, by the bottom-value bound for K_T split over the disjoint translates σ(s)⁻¹K(g), ∑_s |∫ phase|² ≤ 2𝖬(K_T)².
